android.desc:
Make room for a little stillness. Read Vedanta and spiritual classics in a calm library designed for thoughtful study.

Explore the Bhagavad Gita, Upanishads, Atma Bodha, Vivekachudamani, Ashtavakra Gita, Avadhuta Gita, Drg Drsya Viveka, Aparokshanubhuti, Yoga Vasishta Sara, the Complete Works of Swami Vivekananda, and related spiritual resources.

• Read the included texts offline, from your first opening.
• Browse chapters, verses, and topics with searchable contents.
• Find books by title, author, or collection.
• Search for passages within the current reading.
• Select a word for offline English meanings and Sanskrit/Vedanta study notes.
• Listen with an installed device voice and adjust the pace.
• Bookmark a page and the place where you paused.
• Resume your recent reading.
• Choose paper, sepia, or night mode and adjust text size.
• Share selected passages with book credits and an app link.
• Read without accounts or ads.

Texts are prepared from VivekaVani’s Important Spiritual Resources. Translator and publisher credits remain with the source edition. This is an independent reader and is not affiliated with VivekaVani.

Narration uses your phone’s text-to-speech engine. An offline voice must be installed; voice quality and Sanskrit pronunciation vary by device and voice. Playback pauses when the app leaves the foreground.
